eyebrow: Incident Response, Threat Hunting & SOC Capstone · Chapter 1
subtitle: Lesson 4 · The Incident Response Lifecycle

eyebrow: One phase name, three distinct jobs

steps.label: Containment
steps.sub: stop the bleeding — limit further damage, right now

steps.label: Eradication
steps.sub: remove the actual cause so it can't resume

steps.label: Recovery
steps.sub: return systems to verified-clean, normal operation

code:
Eradication before Containment:
  attacker can still reinfect it -- losing battle

Recovery before Eradication:
  cause is still present -- same incident, again
caption: Each phase depends on the one before it actually being finished.

eyebrow: The same incident, all three phases
code:
Containment:  disconnect the workstation from the network
Eradication:  identify and remove the malware, confirmed gone
Recovery:     restore from a clean image, reconnect, verify
caption: Only after all three are done does the incident move into Post-Incident Activity.
